interactions.mechanism: Additive anticoagulant and antiplatelet effects increase bleeding risk.
interactions.source_to_verify: BNF Appendix 1 (Interactions) — warfarin + aspirin; also Stockley's Drug Interactions 12th ed.

interactions.mechanism: Both drugs raise serum potassium. Combined use may cause hyperkalaemia.
interactions.source_to_verify: BNF Appendix 1 — ACE inhibitors + potassium-sparing diuretics; Stockley's Drug Interactions.

interactions.mechanism: Furosemide-induced hypokalaemia may increase digoxin toxicity risk.
interactions.source_to_verify: BNF — digoxin + loop diuretics; Stockley's Drug Interactions.

interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit platelet aggregation and may displace warfarin from plasma proteins, increasing bleeding risk.
interactions.source_to_verify: BNF Appendix 1 — anticoagulants + NSAIDs; Stockley's Drug Interactions.

interactions.mechanism: Alcohol increases risk of lactic acidosis with metformin.
interactions.source_to_verify: Metformin SmPC (Summary of Product Characteristics); BNF — metformin.
